jaisalmer.known_for: Alternative to Sam dunes, less touristy, traditional village, mud-hut stays
jaisalmer.visual_description: Quieter golden sand dunes near a traditional village, mud-hut accommodation, fewer tourists than Sam, authentic desert experience, camel tracks in virgin sand

jaisalmer.name: Manak Chowk Bazaar
jaisalmer.known_for: Market inside and around the fort, mirror-work bags, embroidered textiles
jaisalmer.visual_description: Narrow medieval lanes inside the fort with shops selling mirror-work bags, embroidered textiles, silver jewellery, the commerce of a living fortress

pushkar.name: Pushkar Lake
pushkar.known_for: Sacred lake with 52 bathing ghats, one of Hinduism's holiest sites
pushkar.visual_description: Circular sacred lake ringed by 52 white-stepped ghats, temples reflected in still water, pilgrims bathing and offering flowers, Aravalli hills enclosing it all

pushkar.name: Brahma Temple
pushkar.known_for: One of very few Brahma temples in the world, 14th century, red spire, overlooking lake
pushkar.visual_description: Small red-spired temple overlooking the lake, one of the rarest temples in Hinduism dedicated to Lord Brahma, marble and silver, constant devotion

pushkar.name: Pushkar Camel Fair
pushkar.known_for: Annual November fair with 50,000+ camels, largest camel fair in the world
pushkar.visual_description: Vast sandy ground covered with camels in every direction, Rajasthani men in colorful turbans trading, women in mirror-work, races, music, the world's greatest camel spectacle

pushkar.name: Savitri Temple
pushkar.known_for: Hilltop temple reached by ropeway or 700+ steps, panoramic views, sunrise destination
pushkar.visual_description: Temple perched on a craggy hilltop above the lake, reached by steep steps or ropeway, panoramic view of Pushkar lake and the desert at sunrise

pushkar.name: Varaha Temple
pushkar.known_for: 12th century Vishnu boar avatar temple, one of the oldest structures in Pushkar
pushkar.visual_description: Ancient stone temple dedicated to Vishnu's boar incarnation, partially restored, one of Pushkar's oldest surviving structures, quiet devotion

pushkar.name: Rangji Temple
pushkar.known_for: South Indian-style gopuram in Rajasthan, unusual Dravidian architecture in the desert
pushkar.visual_description: Tall colourful Dravidian gopuram tower rising incongruously in the Rajasthani desert town, South Indian temple architecture transplanted, unique sight

pushkar.name: Apteshwar Temple
pushkar.known_for: Ancient Shiva temple below street level, partly submerged in the lake
pushkar.visual_description: Subterranean temple descending below street level, partly surrounded by lake water, mysterious and atmospheric, ancient Shiva worship in darkness

pushkar.name: Sadar Bazaar
pushkar.known_for: Narrow street with tie-dye textiles, silver jewellery, rose products, backpacker vibe
pushkar.visual_description: Narrow main street with shops selling tie-dye textiles, silver jewellery, leather goods, rose products, international backpackers mixing with pilgrims

pushkar.name: Rose Garden
pushkar.known_for: Pushkar's rose farms on the outskirts, rose water and gulkand production
pushkar.visual_description: Rows of pink and red roses stretching toward the Aravalli hills, the sweet scent filling the air, rose water distillation, gulkand preparation, Pushkar's fragrant identity

pushkar.name: Old Rangji Temple
pushkar.known_for: Older Rangji temple, Mughal-style dome with Rajput elements, eclectic architecture
pushkar.visual_description: Eclectic temple blending Mughal dome, Rajput decorative elements and Hindu iconography, quiet and less visited than the newer Rangji

pushkar.name: Pushkar Ghats
pushkar.known_for: 52 ghats around the lake, ritual bathing, evening aarti, flower offerings
pushkar.visual_description: Stone-stepped ghats descending to the sacred lake, pilgrims and tourists offering flowers, evening aarti with oil lamps floating, bells ringing across the water

pushkar.name: Ajmer Sharif Dargah
pushkar.known_for: Sufi shrine of Moinuddin Chishti in Ajmer, one of the most important Muslim pilgrimage sites
pushkar.visual_description: Grand Sufi shrine through a narrow bazaar, marble courtyard, enormous cauldrons for langar, qawwali singers, devotees tying threads, intense spiritual energy

pushkar.name: Ana Sagar Lake
pushkar.known_for: 12th century lake in Ajmer, Daulat Bagh gardens, marble pavilions
pushkar.visual_description: Wide lake in Ajmer with Mughal-era marble pavilions (baradari) on the embankment, Daulat Bagh gardens, Aravalli hills reflected, calm water

pushkar.name: Taragarh Fort
pushkar.known_for: Ancient hilltop fort above Ajmer, panoramic views, one of the oldest hill forts in India
pushkar.visual_description: Rugged hilltop fort above Ajmer, panoramic view of the city and Ana Sagar Lake below, one of India's oldest hill forts, strenuous but rewarding climb

pushkar.name: Adhai Din Ka Jhonpra
pushkar.known_for: 1199 mosque in Ajmer, originally a Sanskrit college, extraordinary calligraphy
pushkar.visual_description: Ruined arched screen of an Indo-Islamic mosque, originally a Sanskrit college, extraordinary Arabic calligraphy, fading beauty, historical layers

pushkar.name: Nag Pahar
pushkar.known_for: Snake Mountain behind Pushkar, hiking trail with town and lake views
pushkar.visual_description: Rocky Aravalli ridge rising behind the lake, hiking trail through scrub and boulders, panoramic view of Pushkar lake and the desert beyond, raw terrain

pushkar.name: Pushkar Mela Ground
pushkar.known_for: Vast sandy fairground that transforms during the annual camel fair
pushkar.visual_description: Vast flat sandy expanse, usually empty and wind-swept, transformed into a vibrant tent city during the November camel fair, ephemeral spectacle vs. eternal desert

pushkar.name: Sunset Cafe Area
pushkar.known_for: Lakeside cafes and rooftop restaurants, traveller hangout, sunset views
pushkar.visual_description: Cluster of rooftop cafes overlooking the lake and ghats, travellers watching sunset with chai, laid-back atmosphere, the intersection of pilgrimage and backpacker culture

pushkar.name: Kishangarh
pushkar.known_for: Town famous for Bani Thani painting (Indian Mona Lisa), miniature art tradition
pushkar.visual_description: Small town with miniature painting workshops, the Bani Thani painting with her elongated features and lotus in hand, Kishangarh school of art, fort and lake

pushkar.name: Makrana Marble Quarries
pushkar.known_for: Source of Taj Mahal marble, working quarries, brilliant white landscape
pushkar.visual_description: Vast white marble quarries gashed into the hillside, dazzling in the sun, blocks being cut, the very stone that became the Taj Mahal, raw industrial beauty

bikaner.name: Junagarh Fort
bikaner.known_for: 16th century undefeated fort, elaborate palace interiors, Anup Mahal mirror room
bikaner.visual_description: Red sandstone fort with elaborate palace interiors — Anup Mahal's gold and mirror work, Chandra Mahal's paintings, one of Rajasthan's best-preserved fort-palaces

bikaner.name: Karni Mata Temple
bikaner.known_for: The Rat Temple, thousands of revered rats, ornate silver gates
bikaner.visual_description: Ornate temple with silver gates, thousands of rats scurrying across the marble floor, fed and worshipped by devotees, one of India's most unique temples

bikaner.name: Lalgarh Palace
bikaner.known_for: Early 20th century red sandstone palace, Indo-Saracenic, ornate jali work
bikaner.visual_description: Red sandstone palace with intricate jali screens, Indo-Saracenic arches, now partly heritage hotel, the last grand palace of the Bikaner royals

bikaner.name: Camel Research Centre
bikaner.known_for: Government camel breeding and research farm, camel rides, camel milk ice cream
bikaner.visual_description: Vast desert compound with camels of various breeds, camel milk ice cream stall, camel rides, research into desert agriculture, offbeat and educational

bikaner.name: Bhujia Market
bikaner.known_for: Bikaner is India's snack capital, bhujia and namkeen shops in old-city lanes
bikaner.visual_description: Old-city lanes with shops stacked floor to ceiling with bhujia packets, freshly made namkeen, the aroma of roasting spices, Bikaner's edible heritage

bikaner.name: Rampuria Haveli Street
bikaner.known_for: Row of ornate 15th-17th century merchant havelis, red sandstone carvings
bikaner.visual_description: Row of magnificently carved red sandstone havelis, jharokha balconies, one of the finest haveli streets in Rajasthan, merchant wealth frozen in stone

bikaner.name: Gajner Palace
bikaner.known_for: Lakeside hunting lodge 32km away, heritage hotel, desert lake setting, birdwatching
bikaner.visual_description: Red sandstone palace on a desert lake shore, imperial sand grouse flocks, the former royal hunting ground, now a serene heritage hotel, birdwatcher's paradise

bikaner.name: Bhandasar Jain Temple
bikaner.known_for: 15th century Jain temple with ornate interiors and gold-leaf paintings
bikaner.visual_description: Ornate Jain temple with gold-leaf ceiling paintings, intricate carvings, one of Bikaner's architectural gems, serene interior lit by filtered light

bikaner.name: Devi Kund Sagar
bikaner.known_for: Royal cenotaphs of Bikaner rulers on a desert plain
bikaner.visual_description: Ornate carved sandstone cenotaphs spread across a flat desert plain, Bikaner rulers memorialized, desert light and shadow playing on carved stone

bikaner.name: Prachina Museum
bikaner.known_for: Royal textiles, costumes, and artifacts from the Bikaner royal collection inside Junagarh
bikaner.visual_description: Museum inside the fort displaying royal costumes, textiles, perfume bottles, art deco furniture, the private life of the Bikaner maharajas

bikaner.name: Laxminath Temple
bikaner.known_for: Large 16th century Vishnu-Laxmi temple, painted interiors
bikaner.visual_description: Large 16th century temple with brightly painted interiors, Vishnu and Laxmi shrines, old-city landmark, local devotion

bikaner.name: Old City Bazaar Bikaner
bikaner.known_for: Walled city with narrow lanes, sandstone architecture, spice shops
bikaner.visual_description: Narrow lanes within the old walled city, sandstone buildings with carved balconies above, spice and leather shops below, authentic desert city life

bikaner.name: Ganga Golden Jubilee Museum
bikaner.known_for: Archaeological collection including Gupta terracotta, Rajasthani miniatures
bikaner.visual_description: Museum with Gupta-era terracotta, Rajasthani miniature paintings, folk art, archaeological finds from across the Thar region

bikaner.name: Kolayat
bikaner.known_for: Sacred lake 50km away with temples on ghats, Kapil Muni Fair
bikaner.visual_description: Sacred lake in the desert with temples on its ghats, annual Kartik Purnima fair, pilgrims bathing, raw faith in the arid landscape

bikaner.name: Bikaner Camel Festival
bikaner.known_for: Annual January festival with camel races, beauty contests, camel polo
bikaner.visual_description: Sandy fairground with decorated camels, turban-tying contests, camel polo matches, folk dancers, the desert's most exuberant celebration

bikaner.name: Mukam Jambheshwar Temple
bikaner.known_for: Temple of Bishnoi sect founder, eco-spiritual pilgrimage in the desert
bikaner.visual_description: Desert temple of the Bishnoi sect founder, devotees from eco-spiritual villages, the birthplace of India's first environmental movement

bikaner.name: Kodamdesar Temple
bikaner.known_for: Ancient desert temple, remote, atmospheric Thar setting
bikaner.visual_description: Small ancient temple in a remote Thar village, atmospheric desolation around it, authentic desert spirituality far from tourist circuits

bikaner.name: Chhatar Garh
bikaner.known_for: Small fort overlooking the city, panoramic desert views, less visited
bikaner.visual_description: Small sandstone fort on the city outskirts, panoramic desert view, rarely visited, quiet contemplation above Bikaner's rooftops

bikaner.name: Red Sand Dunes
bikaner.known_for: Red-tinged desert dunes near the city, different character from Jaisalmer's golden sand
bikaner.visual_description: Rust-red sand dunes under blue desert sky, different from Jaisalmer's golden sands, camel safaris, local character, sunset glow on red earth

bikaner.name: Bikaner House
bikaner.known_for: The Bikaner royals' Delhi residence, Art Deco-meets-Rajput, cultural centre
bikaner.visual_description: Art Deco palace built by the Bikaner royals in Delhi, now a cultural hub, the outward reach of a desert kingdom into the national capital

chittorgarh.name: Chittorgarh Fort
chittorgarh.known_for: India's largest fort by area, 700 acres, three famous jauhar sites, Rajput valour symbol
chittorgarh.visual_description: Vast hilltop fort stretching 13km, ruined palaces and temples across its plateau, the most storied Rajput stronghold, three jauhars scarred into its stones

chittorgarh.name: Vijay Stambha
chittorgarh.known_for: 37m nine-storey carved tower of victory, 1448, 157 steps, Mewar's icon
chittorgarh.visual_description: Towering nine-storey carved sandstone victory tower, intricate sculptures on every face, 157 steps spiralling to panoramic views, the icon of Mewar

chittorgarh.name: Kirti Stambha
chittorgarh.known_for: 22m 12th century Jain tower of fame, intricately carved, older than Vijay Stambha
chittorgarh.visual_description: Slender 12th century Jain tower with detailed carvings of Jain tirthankaras, older and more austere than Vijay Stambha, quiet dignity

chittorgarh.name: Rana Kumbha Palace
chittorgarh.known_for: Ruined royal palace where Padmini and Meera Bai lived, the oldest in the fort
chittorgarh.visual_description: Sprawling ruined palace with crumbling walls and empty chambers, the oldest palace in the fort, where queens lived and legends were born

chittorgarh.name: Padmini Palace
chittorgarh.known_for: Lakeside palace where Khilji reportedly saw Rani Padmini's reflection
chittorgarh.visual_description: Small palace on a lake within the fort, pavilion on the water, the legend of Rani Padmini's reflection in the mirror, romantic and tragic

chittorgarh.name: Meera Temple
chittorgarh.known_for: Temple associated with the mystic poet Meera Bai, Indo-Aryan architecture
chittorgarh.visual_description: Stone temple where Meera Bai composed her devotional songs to Krishna, Indo-Aryan shikhara, the poetry and devotion of a rebel queen

chittorgarh.name: Kalika Mata Temple
chittorgarh.known_for: 8th century Sun Temple converted to Kali temple, one of the fort's oldest
chittorgarh.visual_description: Ancient temple with 8th century Sun Temple origins, now dedicated to Kali, carved stone, one of the fort's oldest standing structures

chittorgarh.name: Kumbha Shyam Temple
chittorgarh.known_for: 15th century Vaishnava temple with fine carvings within the fort
chittorgarh.visual_description: 15th century temple with intricate carvings of Vishnu's incarnations, within the fort, fine Mewar temple architecture, devotional atmosphere

chittorgarh.name: Jauhar Kund
chittorgarh.known_for: Site of the mass self-immolation of Rajput women, sombre and powerful memorial
chittorgarh.visual_description: Stone-edged sacred pool where Rajput queens and women performed jauhar, sombre atmosphere, bare stone, the most emotionally heavy spot in the fort

chittorgarh.name: Fateh Prakash Palace
chittorgarh.known_for: 20th century palace within the fort, museum of Mewar sculptures
chittorgarh.visual_description: Palace within the fort housing Mewar sculptures and artifacts, the last grand building in a fort of ruins, royal patronage of art

chittorgarh.name: Gaumukh Reservoir
chittorgarh.known_for: Sacred spring emerging from a cow-mouth carved in rock, fort's water source
chittorgarh.visual_description: Natural spring gushing from a carved cow-mouth (gaumukh) in the cliff face, one of the fort's sacred water sources, pilgrims gathering

chittorgarh.name: Surajpol
chittorgarh.known_for: The main gateway to the fort, massive stone portal
chittorgarh.visual_description: Massive stone gateway through which armies marched and defenders fell, the first of seven gates ascending to the fort, dramatically proportioned

chittorgarh.name: Ratan Singh Palace
chittorgarh.known_for: Lakeside palace ruins within the fort, overlooking a water body
chittorgarh.visual_description: Atmospheric palace ruins beside a small lake within the fort, reflected arches in still water, the quiet end of the fort's inhabited area

chittorgarh.name: Nagar Sagar Kund
chittorgarh.known_for: Twin ornamental reservoirs near Vijay Stambha, symmetrical architecture
chittorgarh.visual_description: Twin ornamental stepped reservoirs flanking the main road, symmetrical sandstone architecture, geometrically satisfying

chittorgarh.name: Chittor Town Bazaar
chittorgarh.known_for: Lower town with bazaars, ghats on rivers, modern Chittorgarh life
chittorgarh.visual_description: Busy market town below the fort, riverside ghats, local shops, the living town that grew after the fort was abandoned as a residence

chittorgarh.name: Bassi Wildlife Sanctuary
chittorgarh.known_for: Small sanctuary 25km away, dry deciduous forest, leopard, Bassi Fort
chittorgarh.visual_description: Dry deciduous forest with Bassi Fort visible through the canopy, leopard territory, langurs, the Aravalli forest ecosystem near Chittorgarh

chittorgarh.name: Menal Waterfalls
chittorgarh.known_for: Seasonal waterfall and 11th century temple ruins in a Chambal ravine
chittorgarh.visual_description: Dramatic seasonal waterfall plunging into a deep ravine, 11th century temple ruins perched on the edge, remote Chambal country, raw and powerful

chittorgarh.name: Sanwariyaji Temple
chittorgarh.known_for: Massively popular Krishna temple 40km away, modern grand temple
chittorgarh.visual_description: Huge modern temple complex with enormous crowds, black Krishna idol, marble halls, one of Rajasthan's most visited modern pilgrimage sites

chittorgarh.name: Bijaipur
chittorgarh.known_for: Village with heritage castle-hotel, traditional Rajasthani village life
chittorgarh.visual_description: Rural village with a 16th century castle-turned-hotel, traditional Rajasthani village life around it, pastoral landscape, gateway to the Chambal

chittorgarh.name: Sound and Light Show
chittorgarh.known_for: Evening show at the fort narrating the three sieges and jauhars
chittorgarh.visual_description: The massive fort walls illuminated at night, narration of the three great sieges and jauhars echoing through the darkness, dramatic and emotional

varanasi.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
varanasi.known_for: Main ghat, spectacular Ganga Aarti every evening with fire rituals
varanasi.visual_description: Wide stone steps descending to the Ganges, priests wielding flaming brass lamps in synchronized evening aarti, thousands watching from boats and ghats, smoke and chanting

varanasi.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
varanasi.known_for: One of 12 Jyotirlingas, ancient Shiva temple, gold dome
varanasi.visual_description: Gold-domed Shiva temple in the dense old-city lanes, heavily guarded, streams of devotees, the holiest Shiva shrine, centuries of layered faith

varanasi.name: Manikarnika Ghat
varanasi.known_for: The great cremation ghat, funeral pyres burning 24/7, believed to grant moksha
varanasi.visual_description: Perpetual funeral pyres on stone steps, smoke rising into the sky, wood stacked in tall piles, Doms tending the fire, the most viscerally intense sight in India

varanasi.name: Assi Ghat
varanasi.known_for: Southernmost main ghat, morning puja under a peepal tree, traveller hub
varanasi.visual_description: Wide ghat under a large peepal tree, morning puja with bells and incense, chai vendors, backpackers, music students, the relaxed end of Varanasi's waterfront

varanasi.name: Sarnath
varanasi.known_for: Where Buddha gave his first sermon, Dhamek Stupa, Ashoka Pillar capital
varanasi.visual_description: Wide green park with the circular Dhamek Stupa rising above, excavated monastery foundations, the Ashoka lion capital's origin site, serene Buddhist pilgrimage

varanasi.name: Banaras Hindu University
varanasi.known_for: Asia's largest residential university, 1300-acre campus, Bharat Kala Bhavan museum
varanasi.visual_description: Vast green campus with colonial and modernist buildings, the New Vishwanath Temple's white shikhara, Bharat Kala Bhavan's art treasures, students on bicycles

varanasi.name: Ramnagar Fort
varanasi.known_for: 18th century Maharaja's fort across the Ganges, museum, month-long Ram Leela
varanasi.visual_description: Honey sandstone fort on the far bank of the Ganges, vintage car museum inside, dusty royal artefacts, the month-long Ram Leela spectacle, atmospheric decay

varanasi.name: Tulsi Manas Temple
varanasi.known_for: Modern marble temple with Ramcharitmanas engraved on walls
varanasi.visual_description: Pristine white marble temple with the entire Ramcharitmanas engraved on its walls, calm and clean, a modern counterpoint to the ancient ghats

varanasi.name: Durga Temple
varanasi.known_for: 18th century red sandstone Nagara-style temple, monkeys, tank alongside
varanasi.visual_description: Vivid red sandstone temple in Nagara style, tank with green water alongside, langur monkeys leaping on the walls, intense local devotion

varanasi.name: Man Mandir Ghat Observatory
varanasi.known_for: Jai Singh's astronomical observatory on the ghat, stone instruments over the Ganges
varanasi.visual_description: Stone astronomical instruments on a palace above the Ghat, overlooking the Ganges, 18th century science meeting ancient faith, rarely visited

varanasi.name: Alamgir Mosque
varanasi.known_for: Aurangzeb-era mosque on Panchganga Ghat, prominent minarets on the skyline
varanasi.visual_description: Twin minarets of a Mughal mosque rising above Panchganga Ghat, Hindu-Muslim layered architecture, one of Varanasi's most prominent skyline elements

varanasi.name: Bharat Kala Bhavan Museum
varanasi.known_for: Outstanding miniature paintings, sculptures, textiles collection within BHU
varanasi.visual_description: University museum with exquisite miniature paintings, Gandhara sculptures, ancient textiles, one of India's finest art collections in a quiet academic setting

varanasi.name: Kabir Chaura
varanasi.known_for: Heritage site of poet-saint Kabir, math and weaving community
varanasi.visual_description: Narrow lanes in the weaver's quarter, the math (monastery) of Kabir, looms clicking in nearby houses, mystical Varanasi where poetry and cloth interweave

varanasi.name: Silk Weaving Workshops
varanasi.known_for: Handloom Banarasi silk saree workshops, zari work, centuries-old craft
varanasi.visual_description: Narrow house-workshops with handlooms, weavers creating intricate gold zari patterns on silk, the click-clack of looms, Banarasi sarees emerging thread by thread

varanasi.name: Shivala Ghat
varanasi.known_for: 19th century ghat with Nepali temple, wooden pagoda-style, eclectic architecture
varanasi.visual_description: Ghat with a Nepali wooden pagoda-style temple among the stone buildings, eclectic architecture, quieter than the main ghats, intimate waterfront

varanasi.name: Chet Singh Fort
varanasi.known_for: 18th century riverside fort and ghat, battle site against Warren Hastings
varanasi.visual_description: Stone fortification rising directly from the river, dramatic walls, site of an 18th century battle, atmospheric riverside approach

varanasi.name: Godowlia Chowk
varanasi.known_for: Chaotic vibrant central crossroads of old Varanasi, lanes to temples and ghats
varanasi.visual_description: Chaotic intersection where lanes radiate to every ghat and temple, rickshaws, motorcycles, cows, saree shops, the urban heart of old Varanasi

varanasi.name: Blue Lassi Shop area
varanasi.known_for: Narrow lanes famous for lassi and thandai, old-city food culture
varanasi.visual_description: Tiny hole-in-the-wall lassi shops in narrow lanes, clay cups of thick creamy lassi, saffron thandai, old-city food culture at its most intimate

varanasi.name: Chunar Fort
varanasi.known_for: Ancient fort 40km away on a rocky cliff over the Ganges, Mughal and British history
varanasi.visual_description: Massive fort on a rocky cliff overhanging the Ganges, strategic for millennia, Mughal and British layers, panoramic river views, rarely visited

varanasi.name: Lolark Kund
varanasi.known_for: Ancient sun-worship stepped well, one of the oldest structures in Varanasi
varanasi.visual_description: Ancient stepped well descending into darkness, sun worship site, one of Varanasi's oldest structures, atmospheric stone walls, Chhath Puja crowds

lucknow.name: Bara Imambara
lucknow.known_for: Massive 1784 Nawabi hall, one of the largest arched constructions without beams, Bhool Bhulaiya labyrinth
lucknow.visual_description: Enormous arched hall without beams or pillars, the Bhool Bhulaiya labyrinth of narrow passages above, Nawabi grandeur in crumbling stucco, atmospheric and disorienting

lucknow.name: Chota Imambara
lucknow.known_for: Ornate 1838 congregation hall, gilded dome, chandeliers, Palace of Lights
lucknow.visual_description: Ornate hall glittering with chandeliers, gilded interiors, Belgian glass, calligraphy, the Palace of Lights, Nawabi elegance at its most concentrated

lucknow.name: Rumi Darwaza
lucknow.known_for: 60-foot ornamental gateway modeled on Istanbul, Lucknow's most iconic symbol
lucknow.visual_description: Towering ornamental gateway with intricate stucco work, Nawabi Lucknow's signature silhouette, dramatically lit at night, vehicles passing through the arch

lucknow.name: British Residency
lucknow.known_for: Ruined 1857 siege complex, bullet-scarred walls, memorial park
lucknow.visual_description: Ruined colonial buildings with bullet-scarred and cannonball-pocked walls, overgrown gardens, 1857 graves, one of India's most evocative Mutiny-era ruins

lucknow.name: Hazratganj
lucknow.known_for: Premier shopping street, colonial-era arcaded buildings, mix of heritage and modern
lucknow.visual_description: Wide avenue with colonial arcaded shopfronts, modern retail alongside heritage bookshops, the elegant commercial heart of Lucknow

lucknow.name: Chowk Market
lucknow.known_for: Old city market famous for chikankari embroidery, kebabs, Nawabi-era architecture
lucknow.visual_description: Narrow lanes packed with chikankari embroidery shops, kebab stalls with smoke rising, Nawabi-era buildings above, the authentic old Lucknow experience

lucknow.name: Ambedkar Memorial Park
lucknow.known_for: Vast modern memorial in red sandstone, 107-acre park with elephant statues
lucknow.visual_description: Vast geometric red sandstone park with 60 elephant statues, grand modern political architecture, wide open spaces, Mayawati-era statement in stone

lucknow.name: La Martiniere College
lucknow.known_for: 1836 palatial school, one of the most extraordinary school buildings in the world
lucknow.visual_description: Enormous palatial school building blending Baroque and Nawabi styles, riverside setting, still a functioning school, one of the most extraordinary buildings in India

lucknow.name: Jama Masjid Lucknow
lucknow.known_for: Grand Mughal-era mosque near Hussainabad, twin minarets, large courtyard
lucknow.visual_description: Grand mosque with twin minarets and wide courtyard, central to old Lucknow's skyline, the Islamic architectural heritage of the Nawabs

lucknow.name: Lucknow Zoo
lucknow.known_for: Historic zoo from 1921, white tiger breeding, heritage layout in city centre
lucknow.visual_description: Colonial-era zoo with heritage layout, white tigers, old trees, families on weekend outings, a nostalgic green space in the city centre

lucknow.name: Dilkusha Kothi
lucknow.known_for: Ruined British-era garden palace modeled on English country house
lucknow.visual_description: Romantic ruin of a British garden palace, arched windows open to sky and trees, atmospheric overgrown grounds, a melancholy English country house in India

lucknow.name: Chattar Manzil
lucknow.known_for: Umbrella-domed palace on the Gomti River, Nawab's court
lucknow.visual_description: Riverside palace with distinctive umbrella-shaped domes, the Nawab's court on the Gomti, Nawabi-era elegance, now a museum

lucknow.name: Hussainabad Picture Gallery
lucknow.known_for: Portrait gallery of Awadh Nawabs, historical paintings
lucknow.visual_description: Gallery of Nawab portraits in an old building near the Imambaras, the faces of Lucknow's rulers staring from gilt frames, historical intimacy

lucknow.name: Aminabad Market
lucknow.known_for: Bustling old market with chikankari shops, street food, authentic bazaar atmosphere
lucknow.visual_description: Dense bazaar lanes with chikankari embroidery shops, kulfi vendors, zardozi work, the bustling authentic Lucknow shopping experience beyond Hazratganj

lucknow.name: Hussainabad Clock Tower
lucknow.known_for: Tallest clock tower in India at 67m, Victorian Gothic
